jobs.name: speed-flare-low
jobs.prompt: Create a polished 3D product photograph for the fictional brand NIGHT LAB. Fixed front three-quarter camera. Two identical ivory ceramic coffee mugs sit well apart on a dark walnut laboratory desk, left mug at 28 percent of image width, right mug at 72 percent. Both mugs have a clearly printed teal owl emblem above the exact words NIGHT LAB; handles face right. Between the mugs is a small rounded teal owl mascot with amber eyes, cream belly and tiny round spectacles. A brass desk lamp is at the far right; a closed notebook lies behind the mugs. Warm studio lighting, dark navy background, premium realistic ceramic reflections, clean balanced layout. Both mugs must be completely visible with clear space around them. No other text, no watermark.

jobs.name: complexity-low
jobs.prompt: Design a precise dark-mode infographic titled NIGHT LAB PIPELINE. Exactly six equal rectangular boxes arranged in two rows of three. Top row left to right: OBSERVE, ASK, TEST. Bottom row left to right: RECORD, REVIEW, SHARE. Exactly five arrows: OBSERVE to ASK; ASK to TEST; TEST vertically down then left to RECORD; RECORD to REVIEW; REVIEW to SHARE. Route the TEST-to-RECORD connector outside the boxes. Boxes 1 and 4 teal, boxes 2 and 5 amber, boxes 3 and 6 cream. Each box contains its exact uppercase label and one small matching line icon. A small owl emblem centered above the title. No extra boxes, arrows, labels, numbers or decorative text. Legible white type, dark navy background, disciplined grid, crisp professional typography.

Preserve the sketched silhouette and wing positions. Centered front view on a plain dark navy background. Friendly premium toy render, no text.

jobs.prompt: Use the input owl as the exact character reference. The same centered full-body teal owl gently raises its right wing in greeting, blinks, lowers wing, and returns toward the original pose. Fixed camera, consistent scale, spectacles and colors, plain identical dark navy background. No text or frame labels.
